dedup_rules: Do not infer identity from one-character distance, phonetics, automatic Han conversion or Latin similarity; these generate review candidates only.
Every proposed new identity must still have zero global owners under all reviewed spellings in fresh TEST and PROD snapshots. A newly discovered owner changes status to HOLD; never insert around it.
Reuse 杉内寿子 only as TEST 10622 / PROD 4836, actual canonical 本田寿子. Exact catalog row/ancillary preimages must match the fresh capture.
No near-owner deletion, FK migration, canonical rename, alias/name/staging mutation is approved by this proposal.

capture_seed.authority: Historical membership only; require a new read-only exact capture and independent slot decision before execution. Freeze these IDs/sides as the upper bound; added or already-bound slots become reviewed drift, never auto-approved.
capture_seed.digest_encoding: JSON ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon), UTF-8; file pins are full byte SHA-256.

capture_requirements: Use read-only repeatable-read transactions separately in TEST and PROD. Capture all 33 exact raw spellings and exactly these 7373 historical (album_id,side,raw) seeds, including current NULL/non-NULL and duplicate status. Reconcile any additions/removals/FK drift explicitly.

For every captured album retain the full row, both player FKs and raw names/ranks, event/event_id/edition, date/title/result, duplicate flags, complete SGF bytes and SHA-256, parsed root properties and digest, all album_sources and source catalog rows.

Capture global player catalog, every name and alias row, per-raw staging entries, and all existing binding rows for 杉内寿子/本田寿子. Scan raw/native/traditional/simplified/Latin spellings again; preserve actual per-environment catalog IDs.

Capture each near-owner queue candidate catalog row, all names/aliases, all albums whose either player FK references it, and all exact variant-raw albums with full SGF/source rows. The 12 historical leads are starting points, not an exhaustive owner reference set.
Compare TEST/PROD semantic rows and SGF/source bytes. Differences in environment IDs must be explained through exact canonical bindings; no general allowance for mismatches.

Parse all candidate SGFs and check PB/PW vs exact slot raw, DT vs album date, career window, rank chronology, opponent identity, event title/region, source/root SO consistency, result, duplicate/setup/handicap/training artifacts. Unknown/corrupt/conflicting contexts are HOLD until exact evidence resolves them.

1900 dates, January-1 placeholders, pre-birth/pre-pro games, amateur ranks, missing career dates, implausible ranks and metadata corruption never pass solely because the raw identity is verified. Amateur pre-pro games require exact official match evidence.

Preserve every prior frozen HOLD and all 2469 identity-HOLD slots. Intersect exact (album_id,side) memberships against prior player decisions; opposite-side prior HOLD stays untouched. Event/player context changes after capture require a SHA-pinned exact per-album rebase from applied artifacts.

The next independent decision must enumerate exact approved and held slots, all full preimage/source/SGF hashes, exact TEST/PROD existing targets or creation order, all source/plan pins, and the allowed DB changes. This identity proposal authorizes no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.

execution_constraints.hold_policy: All nine listed identity HOLD raws remain entirely HOLD unless a later independent decision explicitly resolves them. Do not broaden the 24-raw candidate list while executing a frozen safe subset.
